title: Research sources
unavailable.title: Research review is not available here
unavailable.body: This workspace client does not provide source inspection. Use a connected administration session.
noRelease.title: Publish a release first
noRelease.body: Reviewed resources attach to an immutable published release.
untrusted.title: Untrusted until reviewed
untrusted.body: Search results and fetched pages are untrusted external content. An approval records an evidence-backed content-use decision, not a truth certificate. Attached resources are optional help for learners and never count as progress or mastery.
release.label: Release
topics.title: Approved research topics
topics.empty.title: No public research topics
topics.empty.body: This release declares no author-approved public research topics.
topic.domainsAny: Domains: any public HTTPS host chosen by staff
youtube.saved: YouTube results saved as unreviewed leads. Only this topic's approved query was sent.
youtube.summary: {count, plural, one {# YouTube result} other {# YouTube results}} · metadata only, unreviewed
youtube.searched: Searched {when} for “{query}”. A title is not a review: inspect and review before attaching.
suggestions.summary: {count, plural, one {# unreviewed research suggestion} other {# unreviewed research suggestions}}
source.added: Source approved for inspection. Its content is not reviewed yet.
source.heading: {kind, select, youtube {Video} other {Web page}} · {title}
source.headingUninspected: {kind, select, youtube {Video} other {Web page}} · Not yet inspected
source.failed: Last inspection failed: {reason} ({when}). No content was stored.
review.title: Review inspected content
review.rationaleHint: At least 20 characters. Learners see an approval's rationale as “why this helps”.
review.quoteHint: Copy text exactly from the inspected content (20–800 characters).
review.missing: {count, plural, one {# quote does not appear exactly in the inspected text.} other {# quotes do not appear exactly in the inspected text.}} The server will refuse an approval that cites it.
check.topicRelevant: Relevant to the approved topic and episode objectives
check.accurateEnoughForUse: Accurate enough to use (checked against the course's own material)
check.safeForAudience: Safe and appropriate for the learner audience
review.referenceEmbed: Provider embedded player; no download or redistribution.
review.referenceLink: Linked with attribution only; no copying.
segment.help: Only the part you actually watched. Learners' player starts and stops there. Leave empty if you did not watch a specific part; a title or description is never a segment.
segment.order: The end must come after the start.
review.truncation: I reviewed knowing the inspected text was truncated.
add.title: Add a source to inspect
add.intro: Adding a source authorizes only bounded inspection for {topic}. Nothing is shown to learners until it is reviewed and attached.
add.urlHint: No query text, credentials or custom ports.
add.fallbackHint: Required to approve a video: describe what it explains so learners who cannot watch get the same help. Transcripts are never scraped.
add.daysHint: After expiry the source cannot be inspected, reviewed or delivered.
attach.done: Resource attached as optional help for that episode.
attach.title: Attach as optional help
attach.intro: Learners in this release see the resource as optional help in the chosen episode. It never unlocks progress or records mastery.
attach.daysHint: At most {max, number} day(s), the source approval's remaining life.
delivered.title: Delivered to learners
delivered.caption: Attached research resources
revoke.done: Attachment revoked. Learners no longer see it.
revoke.title: Revoke attached resource
revoke.reasonHint: 10–1000 characters. Kept in the audit history.
